notes: Every model is scored on one pass.

Jev 1.14's answers and cost come from a pass run at 23:49 EDT on 2026-10-16, when TypeSafe answered about 1.2 s slower; its typical search time comes from its earlier pass at 14:13 EDT, close to the other models' 15:17 EDT run (timing_from).

Searches that hit a provider error were run again in full until they finished (resume --redo-failed). On 2026-10-17, 14 searches slower than 3x their model's median time (provider stalls) were also run again in full (resume --redo-slow 3); none changed found or missed.
